newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens bridge over mighty Yangtze.
newsitem.headline: China opens bridge over mighty Yangtze.

text.p: China has opened a 730 million yuan ($88 million) bridge over the mighty Yangtze River in southwestern Sichuan province, the Xinhua news agency said.
The 1,350-metre bridge, which was partly funded by Japan's Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund, opened to traffic on Sunday, the official agency said in an overnight report.
The bridge was the second to span the Yangtze at Chongqing, Sichuan's largest city, and had been under construction since 1991, Xinhua said but without giving further details of its construction.
